proposal.name: Replay current bugs through Python application checks

plan.name: Replay current bugs through Python application checks
plan.summary: Finish parent #789 by running every required current-bug path through the authenticated existing-Python collector, for every selected conformance invocation in both explicit and legacy projects, independently of sampled or exhaustive mode. Add invariant_observe.replay(start, steps) and a prepared-session RunBugReplay API that reuse functional, instance and module lifecycle bindings, exact declared exceptions and held-call rules; the collector owns operation order, actual dispatch, read-back, fresh identity and completion, and the common replay checker rejects reproduction and accepts only a checked refusal or valid alternative after the exact prefix. Keep independent test, proof and conformance evidence when replay fails, require all bug/invocation pairs before the gate passes, preserve the staged source/model and dependency image, and keep deterministic replay out of sampled coverage and exploration-prefix accounting. Retain each execution and checked result in application and bug evidence, portable fingerprints, JSON, Markdown and dashboard views, and replace the existing tests, factory notices and agent guidance that pin the temporary Python-adapter limitation while retaining temporal and unsupported-binding failures; explicitly tell existing-Python driver writers never to reach into invariant_observe and reviewers to report any such tampering, because the collector shares the driver's process and review is the check against it (D-0483). Update SPEC.md, README.md, docs/gate.md, docs/python.md, docs/factory.md and docs/dashboard.md to describe the completed interface, trust boundary and evidence, cite this ratified plan in changed SPEC bullets, preserve existing authentication and scheduling assertions, and leave only additional decisions not stated here or one-way doors for the merger to record.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationBugReplayLifecycles935
tests.says: The real collector executes both delivery/recovery bug paths and repaired refusals with exact parameters through module, functional and instance lifecycles, for explicit and legacy selections.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationBugReplayRejectsMissingAndInvalidCalls935
tests.says: A real replay can finish, but missing dispatch, wrong bindings, arbitrary or mismatched exceptions, changed continuity and premature exit cannot finish one.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationBugReplayAuthenticatesAndCleansUp935
tests.says: Fresh signed observations are required for each replay; stale or corrupted streams, changed inputs, cancellation, process and cleanup failures supply no accepted replay evidence.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationBugReplayHeldCalls935
tests.says: Required replay preserves held-worker start/release accounting and exact declared refusals, without claiming another selected call on release.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationBugReplayGate935
tests.says: Public admission and the full gate execute every bug/invocation pair even when sampling misses both bugs or exhaustive mode is selected, retain independent evidence, and fail any missing or reproduced obligation.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationBugReplayFingerprints935
tests.says: Replay execution and model results survive JSON round trips, bind exact state and operation evidence into fingerprints, exclude fresh transport identity, and never inflate sampled coverage.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationBugReplayReceipt935
tests.says: Markdown and JSON retain each application's bug, selected invocation, execution and checked replay outcome separately from sampled conformance and escape untrusted text.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationReplayAvailability935
tests.says: Existing Python safety bugs no longer produce the temporary unavailable-adapter notice, while temporal current bugs still do.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationReplayGuidance935
tests.says: Writer and reviewer guidance describe authenticated application replay and real selected calls, warn writers never to reach into invariant_observe, and require review to report such tampering because the collector shares the driver's process.

tests.name: TestDashboardPythonApplicationReplays935
tests.says: The dashboard retains and presents every Python bug/invocation outcome without merging it into model catch or sampled coverage, and no longer marks the supported adapter unavailable.

usage.summary: Revised `plan.json` and acceptance tests address all five requested corrections while preserving one complete change. Check 1 passed: all ten acceptance tests fail on the base as required.
